title: Great products; definitely order through Amazon.
text:
I definitely prefer ordering the Allure Beauty Box from Amazon. Every time I subscribed to the Allure site, I never received the box. ???
I do really like the products. They are high quality and that’s what I look for in beauty products. I like the variety that’s included and the price is really great. I also enjoy the booklet that describes the products. But definitely order this from Amazon. Amazon delivers right on time. Ordering directly from Allure is a mistake. Allure is not dependable.
label: positive
